```{r}
shift = read.csv("Bucknell_ShiftMed_Data_File.csv", header = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
popfocus = c("Philadelphia-Wilmington-Atlantic City PA-NJ-DE-MD CMSA", "Washington-Baltimore DC-MD-VA-WV CMSA", "Pittsburgh PA MSA", "St. Louis MO-IL MSA", "New York-Northern New Jersey-Long Island NY-NJ-CT-PA")
typefocus = c("CNA","LPN","RN","GNA","STNA")
smallshift = shift[shift$nurse_type %in% typefocus, ]
shiftfocus = smallshift[smallshift$nurse_msa %in% popfocus, ]
shiftworkers = shift[shift$shifts_worked > 0, ]
shiftfocusworkers = shiftfocus[shiftfocus$shifts_worked > 0, ]
shift$ogshowrate = shift$shifts_worked / shift$total_shifts_claimed
shift$newshowrate = shift$shifts_worked / (shift$shifts_worked + shift$shifts_call_out)
shiftfocus$ogshowrate = shiftfocus$shifts_worked / shiftfocus$total_shifts_claimed
shiftfocus$newshowrate = shiftfocus$shifts_worked / (shiftfocus$shifts_worked + shiftfocus$shifts_call_out)
shiftworkers$ogshowrate = shiftworkers$shifts_worked / shiftworkers$total_shifts_claimed
shiftworkers$newshowrate = shiftworkers$shifts_worked / (shiftworkers$shifts_worked + shiftworkers$shifts_call_out)
shiftfocusworkers$ogshowrate = shiftfocusworkers$shifts_worked / shiftfocusworkers$total_shifts_claimed
shiftfocusworkers$newshowrate = shiftfocusworkers$shifts_worked / (shiftfocusworkers$shifts_worked + shiftfocusworkers$shifts_call_out)
```

```{r}
shift$first = as.Date(shift$install_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
shift$last = as.Date(shift$first_shift_claimed_on_platform, format = "%m/%d/%Y") #flipped to available next
shift$time_diff = as.numeric(shift$last - shift$first)

shift$first2 = as.Date(shift$flipped_to_available, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
shift$last2 = as.Date(shift$first_shift_claimed_on_platform, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
shift$time_diff2 = as.numeric(shift$last2 - shift$first2)

#shift$first3 = as.Date(shift$intall_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
#shift$last3 = as.Date(shift$first_shift_claimed_on_platform, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
shift$time_diff3 = as.numeric(shift$first2 - shift$first)
```

```{r}

shift$cancelratio = (shift$shifts_call_out + shift$shifts_caregiver_cancel + shift$shifts_unscheduled) / shift$fac_cancelled_shift #total shifts cancelled / total shifts facs cancelled
```

```{r}

```
```{r}
sum(shift$cancelratio <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(shift$wshiftratio >= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
9674 / 22843
```
9674 people had more fac cancelled shifts than shifts cancelled of their own accord (42.3% of workers)
1452 people had half of their total shifts be guaranteed shifts

```{r}

num_cols <- shiftfocus %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  names()

shiftfocus3 <- shiftfocus %>%
  filter(
    if_all(
      all_of(num_cols),
      ~ . >= quantile(., 0.01, na.rm = TRUE) - 
           1.5 * IQR(., na.rm = TRUE) &
        . <= quantile(., 0.99, na.rm = TRUE) + 
           1.5 * IQR(., na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
#should we remove outliers?

```

shiftfocus is representative of the population (shift). shiftworkers seems to have the highest numbers of all the slices, seemingly due to the fact it is literally the workers who have actually showed up. shiftfocusworkers is not far off. the question is: how can we get those in the population to actually work?
